facts.claim: The buff folders of the living are kept on the shelf at Roeder's elbow, the old case among them.
facts.quote: the buff folders of the living, kept at his elbow so he might reach them without rising

facts.claim: Brandt draws the old-numbered folder from the shelf and feeds it into the consulting-room stove.
facts.quote: she drew one out by its number, which she knew without reading ... and she ... fed the folder in

facts.claim: Hélène draws the forged papers from the writing-case and pushes them across to Cendre, who keeps them.
facts.quote: drew the papers, and laid them on the table between them, and pushed them across
